answer: In a convolutional neural network, a feature map is the output produced by applying filters or kernels to the input data through convolutional layers. It consists of a two-dimensional array of values that represent the activations of these filters across the spatial dimensions of the input. Feature maps play a crucial role in representation learning by capturing hierarchical features at various levels of abstraction, ranging from low-level edges and textures in early layers to complex object parts and semantic concepts in deeper layers.
